project.name: Secure Testing Center Environment
project.description: A locked-down exam proctoring desktop application that students download and install on their own machines to take exams remotely. Built with Electron, it provides kiosk-mode lockdown, media capture, VM detection, and AI-blocking to ensure academic integrity.

objectives: OBJ-1: Lock the student's workstation to the exam interface only during exam sessions
OBJ-2: Record camera, microphone, and screen throughout the exam for proctoring review
OBJ-3: Block all AI assistants (Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Perplexity) and all web browsers
OBJ-4: Block unauthorized programs, processes, and software from running during the exam
OBJ-5: Resist hacking, bypass attempts, VM spoofing, remote desktop access, and tampering
OBJ-6: Detect and flag unauthorized voices, absent students, and suspicious gaze patterns
OBJ-7: Provide a secure question bank with quiz import/export capabilities
OBJ-8: Upload all recordings and audit logs to the university server
OBJ-9: Support both Windows and macOS with platform-specific lockdown implementations
OBJ-10: Provide a pre-exam verification sequence (environment scan, room scan, voice calibration, digital signature)

behaviors._description: Rules that every module and every developer/agent MUST follow when making changes to this codebase.
rules: RULE-1: Security-first — every feature must be designed with the assumption that the student is actively trying to bypass it
RULE-2: Defense-in-depth — no single security check should be a single point of failure; always layer multiple checks
RULE-3: Platform abstraction — never call OS-specific commands directly from lockdown/media/security modules; always go through src/platform/
RULE-4: Context isolation — the renderer process must NEVER have direct access to Node.js APIs; all communication goes through the preload contextBridge
RULE-5: No network leaks — during an active exam session, the only allowed network destination is the exam server; everything else must be blocked at both the application and OS firewall level
RULE-6: Audit everything — every security-relevant event (blocked process, blocked shortcut, VM detection, voice mismatch, etc.) must be logged via src/security/auditLog.js
RULE-7: Fail-secure — if a security check fails or throws an error, the default behavior must be to BLOCK the action, not allow it
RULE-8: No silent failures — if camera/mic/screen recording fails, warn the student AND flag the proctor; never silently continue without recording
RULE-9: Encrypted at rest — all locally cached data (recordings, voiceprints, question banks) must be AES-256 encrypted
RULE-10: Read this file first — any agent or developer modifying this codebase MUST read project-config.json before making changes to understand the full context

features.name: Encrypted data at rest and in transit

stack.native: node-addon-api (C++ addons for keyboard hooks, CPUID)

modules.src/main/: Electron shell — app entry point, window management, menu override
modules.src/browser/: Secure browser — locked Chromium, URL filtering, AI request blocking, DNS blocking, web traffic logging
modules.src/lockdown/: Lockdown engine — process monitor, network filter, input guard, environment scanner. Delegates all OS calls to src/platform/
modules.src/platform/: Platform abstraction layer — unified API with win32/ and darwin/ implementations. ALL OS-specific code lives here.
modules.src/platform/win32/: Windows implementations — processes (wmic/tasklist), firewall (New-NetFirewallRule), keyboard (SetWindowsHookEx), clipboard, display, VM detection
modules.src/platform/darwin/: macOS implementations — processes (ps/pkill), firewall (pfctl), keyboard (CGEventTap), clipboard, display, VM detection, TCC permissions
modules.src/media/: Media capture — camera, microphone, screen recording, room scan. Uses getUserMedia and desktopCapturer.
modules.src/renderer/: Exam UI — HTML/CSS/JS exam interface, timer, digital signature, re-entry guard. Runs in isolated renderer process.
modules.src/proctoring/: Proctoring intelligence — voice calibration, voiceprint verification, gaze detection, presence monitoring, behavior analysis
modules.src/security/: Security layer — AES-256 encryption, binary integrity checks, audit logging, anti-tamper detection
modules.src/questionBank/: Question bank — SQLite storage, CSV/JSON import, export. Course designers import quizzes from LMS systems.
modules.config/: Configuration files — blocklists (processes, domains, shortcuts) and whitelists (allowed domains)
modules.scripts/: OS-level scripts — PowerShell (Windows) and shell (macOS) scripts for firewall setup and permissions

dependency_rules: src/renderer/ → CANNOT import from src/main/, src/lockdown/, src/platform/, or any Node.js module directly
src/renderer/ → communicates with main process ONLY through preload.js contextBridge
src/lockdown/ → MUST use src/platform/ for all OS-specific operations
src/media/ → MUST use src/platform/ for permission checks on macOS
src/security/ → can be imported by any module
src/browser/ → runs in main process; controls webContents of the secure browser window

blocklists._note: Detailed lists are in config/blocklist.json. Summary below.

security_policies.admin_exit: Complex password (minimum 12 characters, mixed case, numbers, symbols) entered via hidden admin panel
security_policies.audit_log_format: JSON Lines (.jsonl), each entry timestamped with ISO-8601
security_policies.voiceprint_storage: Encrypted locally per-session, deleted after upload
security_policies.binary_integrity: SHA-256 hash of app binary verified on startup against server-signed manifest

pre_exam_sequence: 2. Environment scan runs (VM detection, RDP detection, process scan, multi-monitor check)
3. If environment is clean, show login screen
5. Camera + microphone + screen recording permissions requested
6. Desk/room scan — student shows surroundings via webcam
7. Voice calibration — student reads 3-5 randomized phrases aloud
8. Digital signature — student signs to confirm identity and accept integrity policy
9. Kiosk lockdown activates (full-screen, shortcuts blocked, processes killed, firewall rules set)
10. Exam begins — timer starts, all media recording active
